contamination.definition: contaminated = exact or near-duplicate of a v2 pretraining sentence; clean = neither
contamination.method: exact: sentence key (letters+digits) over every v2 train sentence; near: MinHash word-3-gram, 16x8 LSH, agreement >= 0.8, only in the listed sources

decode_cap.formula: max_new = ceil(ratio * factor * (prompt_len - 2)) + extra, capped by eval.max_new_tokens
